title: Ubisoft Open-Sources the CHORD Model and ComfyUI Nodes for End-to-End PBR Material Generation
author: fisj

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: This model is practically unusable with their current license. Its a huge shame, since they used other open source content and tooling like MatSynth and CC0 content from popular texture sites. That said, its still an interesting paper, and I expect we can look forward to permissively licensed models like this in the future.
